reasoning_content:
Need a display. Run with offscreen platform to verify import/startup. Use QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen and timeout. Since app.exec() blocks, use xvfb or offscreen with timeout to see it doesn't crash immediately.

Let me run with a timeout and offscreen.

action.command: cd /workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen timeout 8 pomodoro; ec=$?; echo "EXIT=$ec (124=timeout means it ran)"
